description: Stereo reverb with a shimmer, feeding a pitch-shifted copy of its own output back into the tail

params.text: Sets the size of the room, small and tight at one end and wide at the other
Damps the high frequencies in the tail, none at one end and heavy at the other
Freezes the tail, holding what is in the reverb and keeping it going rather than letting it die
Spreads the tail across the stereo field, from both channels alike to fully wide
Sets how much of the untreated signal is in the output
Sets how much of the reverb is in the output
Sets how much of the pitch-shifted output is fed back into the reverb, which is what makes the shimmer
Sets the interval the fed-back copy is shifted by, from half speed for an octave down to four times for two octaves up
Switches between a soft saturating limit on the output and a hard clip at 7V

inputs.text: The left channel going into the reverb
The right channel going into the reverb
Volts here are added to the room size, a volt being the whole range
Volts here are added to the damping, a volt being the whole range
A trigger here turns the freeze on, and the next one turns it off
Volts here are added to the stereo width, a volt being the whole range
0V to 10V adds to the shimmer feedback across its whole range
Volts here are added to the shimmer interval, a volt shifting it by one step of the ratio
0V to 10V adds to the dry level across its whole range
0V to 10V adds to the reverb level across its whole range

outputs.text: The left channel of the output, carrying the dry and reverb mix
The right channel of the output, carrying the dry and reverb mix
